source_audits.source_type: official annual planning statistics CSV releases
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Open Government Licence v3.0 where published as public-sector information; verify terms for each annual release.
source_audits.coverage_years: Round134 read local 2016-17 through 2024-25 annual planning-statistics CSVs and filtered approved Belfast decision records through 2026-05-19.
source_audits.geographic_scope: Northern Ireland planning applications; this pack filters Belfast/Belfast LPA rows and checks approximate Belfast coordinate envelope.
source_audits.reliability_assessment: strong for administrative planning-statistics rows; usable with caveats for physical city-change interpretation
source_audits.required_caveats: Approval/decision records are administrative planning milestones. They are not construction starts, completions, openings, occupations, final built-form records, or outcome evidence.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use as source-backed planning-decision milestones with source row/file references, approximate point geometry, and visible planning-approval caveats.
